metais help refusals pack — Every code metais pack may refuse with, and its next
step.

Next: metais pack --help
      Prints the operands and flags metais pack takes.

Next: metais limits
      Lists every limit with its default; a limit can be lowered and never
      raised.
  limit.package

Next: metais pack <dir> --out <path>
      Writes the package to a file outside the layout trees: in the source
      directory itself, or anywhere outside it.
  output.destination.in_package
  output.destination.not_directory

Next: metais pack <dir>
      Packs the source directory again once the cause is fixed; nothing was
      written.
  output.destination.nothing_written

Next: metais pack <dir>
      Packs the source directory again once its entry <entry> no longer holds
      the signature; packing it unchanged writes the same bytes.
  package.container.second_end_record

Next: metais pack <dir> --out <path>
      Writes the package to a file; or redirect standard output to a file or a
      pipe, since a package is not written to a terminal.
  usage.archive_to_terminal

Next: metais unpack <package> --out <dir>
      Writes the packed package's source directory, which pack reads.
  usage.not_a_source_directory
